w10_T4_005799: A hotel laundry records its machine time in minutes and bills it to guests in hours. On Monday the linen store held 155 towels, and a delivery added 69 more. Housekeeping then took 130 towels out to the rooms. A wash returned 26 towels to the store, and a guest handed back 3 more. Each towel now in the store is packed into a welcome basket with 8 small soaps. How many soaps go into the baskets altogether?
w10_T4_005805: On Monday morning a garden centre had 236 bags of compost in its yard. Before lunch a lorry delivered 76 bags, and in the early afternoon a second lorry brought 75 more. Later that afternoon 198 bags were sold to a landscaping firm. In the evening the staff split every bag left in the yard into 3 small sacks. Each small sack holds 6 litres of compost. How many litres of compost are in the yard?
w10_T4_005807: A stationery factory filled 53 cartons on each of its 8 production lines. A night shift then packed 77 more cartons. Every carton holds 6 notebooks, and all of them were sent to the warehouse. A returned order added 35 notebooks to the warehouse, and a college sent back 60 more. A dozen forklifts work in that warehouse. How many notebooks are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_005809: A theatre counts its box office money in cents and pays it into the bank in dollars. The stalls have 55 rows, and each row holds 8 seats. A balcony adds 67 more seats, but 142 seats were closed off for repairs. Every seat still in use was sold for 5 cents at the charity matinee, and 62 cents were later refunded to a family who left early. The theatre was built in 1908. How many cents did the theatre keep?
w10_T4_005816: A workshop records its jobs in minutes and quotes them to customers in hours. On Monday morning the store held 56 rolls of wire, and a delivery before lunch added 29 rolls. In the afternoon every roll in the store was cut into 6 working lengths. In the early evening a supplier dropped off 21 more lengths, and a returned order brought 35 lengths back. How many lengths of wire are in the store now?
w10_T4_005817: A brick works measures its output in kilograms and reports it to the council in tonnes. On Monday the yard held 117 pallets of bricks, and a delivery added 67 more pallets. A second yard then opened, making the number of pallets 2 times as large. Every pallet carries 6 crates, each crate holds 7 bundles, and each bundle holds 7 bricks. How many bricks does the works hold?
w10_T4_005822: On Monday morning a school canteen had 193 cartons of juice in the chiller. Before break 21 cartons were sold, and at lunchtime 60 more were taken. In the early afternoon a supplier delivered 53 cartons, and in the evening a sports club donated 57 more. Each carton in the chiller fills 8 small cups. How many cups of juice can the canteen pour?
w10_T4_005826: On Saturday morning a fishmonger had 220 salmon fillets and shared them equally among his 4 market stalls. Ola took the fillets for the stall on the quay. Before lunch she sold 32 fillets from it. In the afternoon the van brought her enough salmon to make her stock 4 times as large as it then was. In the evening she sold another 32 fillets and still finished with more stock than her colleague Bjorn had at his stall. A dozen gulls waited on the roof all day. How many fillets does Ola have left?
w10_T4_005827: A community orchard had 84 crates of pears in the barn and picked 57 more crates in September. Every crate holds 9 pears. The orchard sold 974 pears at the village market. The pears that were left were shared equally among 5 baskets for the harvest festival, and the vicar carried one basket to the church. 44 pears from that basket were eaten during the service. The orchard has 60 trees. How many pears are still in the vicar's basket?
w10_T4_005833: A printing club made 148 badges on each of the 4 days of the county fair. A member also brought 34 badges left over from last year. During the fair 298 badges were given away to visitors. A sponsor then sent the club 36 more badges. At the end the club divided what was left into 2 equal boxes, keeping half of them for next year and sending the other box to a partner club. How many badges are in the box kept for next year?
w10_T4_005837: On Monday morning a school hall held 90 chairs, and the caretaker carried half of them into the gym. During the afternoon a delivery made the number of chairs in the gym 4 times as large. In the evening a second delivery doubled the number of chairs in the gym again. On Tuesday a teacher brought 64 more chairs into the gym. On Wednesday the school borrowed enough chairs from a neighbouring school to make the gym hold 3 times as many as it then did. On Thursday another 32 chairs were carried in from the library. How many chairs are in the gym now?
w10_T4_005842: A bus company sells its tickets in cents and banks the takings in dollars. On Monday there were 199 tickets in the machine, and 42 of them were spoiled and removed. Every remaining ticket was sold for 5 cents during the day. The driver then found 56 cents in the tray, and later 35 cents and 74 cents from earlier journeys. A passenger paid a 46 cent fine at the depot. How many cents does the company have from all of this?
w10_T4_005843: Dmitri's bakery had 132 sacks of flour in the store, and the mill sent 14 more. Each sack fills 5 trays of dough, and every tray is cut into 8 rolls. A neighbour then donated 25 baked rolls to the shop. Dmitri has more rolls this week than his rival Ana does, and his oven takes 40 minutes to heat up. How many rolls does Dmitri have?
w10_T4_005844: A school ordered 180 exercise books for each of its 3 year groups. The office then found 44 more books in a cupboard and added them to the order. All of the books were shared equally among the school's 4 corridors, and Mr Olu took the pile for his corridor. He split that pile equally between the 2 classes he teaches and carried one class's share to their room. Mr Olu's corridor received more books this year than Mrs Kaye's corridor received last year. How many books did he carry to that class?
w10_T4_005848: On Monday morning a nursery had 38 trays of plants, and a lorry delivered 36 more before noon. Each tray holds 8 pots, and every pot holds 5 seedlings. In the afternoon all of the seedlings were split equally between the town's 2 nurseries, so that Rosa and Bruno each took an equal share. In the evening a customer returned 61 seedlings to Rosa. How many seedlings does Rosa have now?
w10_T4_005851: A brewery had 230 barrels in its cellar, and 40 of them were sent away for repair. Each remaining barrel fills 5 kegs. A second cellar was then opened, which doubled the number of kegs the brewery holds. Every keg fills 4 crates of bottles. Piotr looks after more kegs than his colleague Hana does, and the brewery was founded 60 years ago. How many crates of bottles can the brewery fill?
w10_T4_005852: On Monday morning a fireworks shop had 160 boxes on each of its 8 shelves. During the day 1230 boxes were sold for the festival, and in the afternoon 8 boxes were found damaged and thrown out. In the evening a supplier delivered 35 more boxes. Each box in the shop holds 8 rockets. On Tuesday morning 22 rockets were used for a display. How many rockets does the shop have now?
w10_T4_005857: A stamp club began the year with 181 albums in its store. Members donated 15 albums, then 17 more, and later another 24. Each album in the store holds 6 rare stamps. A collector then gave the club 29 loose stamps as well. Ines has donated more albums than Karl has, and a dozen members meet every Thursday. How many stamps does the club hold?
w10_T4_005861: On Monday morning a sawmill cut 194 planks from each of 3 large logs. Before lunch a delivery added 76 planks to the pile. In the afternoon 546 planks were sold to a builder. In the evening a joiner returned 72 planks that were the wrong length. The next morning every plank in the pile was cut into 8 slats. Rui worked on more planks that day than his colleague Tomas did. How many slats does the sawmill have?
w10_T4_005865: On Monday morning a jam factory had 202 crates of fruit, and 29 crates were found spoiled and thrown away. Each good crate holds 9 punnets, and every punnet holds 3 handfuls of berries. In the afternoon a farmer brought 33 more handfuls of berries to the factory. In the evening all of the berries were shared equally among the factory's 6 boiling kettles. How many handfuls of berries are in one kettle?
w10_T4_005869: A water company measures its supply in litres but prints the bill in cubic metres. A pumping station had 91 tanks and built 58 more this year. Each tank holds 6 chambers, every chamber holds 7 cells, and each cell holds 6 litres of water. During the summer 33941 litres were pumped out to the town. How many litres of water are left at the station?
w10_T4_005870: Amira's warehouse held 214 boxes of pens, and a supplier delivered 47 more. Each box holds 6 packets of pens. A cancelled order then put 50 loose packets on the shelves, and a school bought 278 packets. Amira keeps more packets in stock than her colleague Rashid does, and the warehouse has 18 loading doors. How many packets of pens are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_005871: A cannery filled 145 crates on each of its 4 production lines, and a night shift added 78 more crates. Every crate in the store holds 4 tins of soup. During the week 856 tins were sold to a supermarket. The manager then sent half of the tins that were left to a food bank and kept the rest in the store. How many tins did the food bank receive?
w10_T4_005873: A cinema counts its running times in minutes and prints them in hours on the poster. It took 193 bookings for a premiere, then 79 more online and 23 more by telephone. On the night 270 of those bookings were used and the tickets collected. Each booking that went unused is worth 7 loyalty points to the customer. The cinema later cancelled 140 points that had expired, and a promotion added 29 points back. How many loyalty points are there now?
w10_T4_005881: A logistics depot records its journeys in minutes and reports them in hours. On Monday morning each of the 7 vans was loaded with 163 parcels. Before lunch 469 parcels were delivered, and during the afternoon another 266 went out. In the evening the parcels still on board were split equally between the depot's 2 night lorries, and the first lorry set off with its share. Each parcel on that lorry holds 8 packets, and every packet holds 3 leaflets. How many leaflets are on that lorry?
